title: Next generation: Paris Packaging Week unveils its 2027 Future Leaders cohort
summary: Paris Packaging Week has unveiled the ten young professionals who will be celebrated on February 3-4, 2027, at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. Representing businesses across Europe, Africa and North America, they make up the Future Leaders 2027 cohort which, each year, recognizes young professionals for their achievements in materials development, luxury design, manufacturing and entrepreneurship within the packaging industry.
